providers.label: DataForSEO
providers.purpose: The only source that can measure ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overview answers.
providers.unique_value: AI answer visibility across all 6 surfaces. Nothing else here can do this at all.
providers.reason: $0.0519 cannot fund one probe ($0.1805). IRREPLACEABLE: no other provider measures AI answers.
providers.action: Top up. Until then AI Visibility reports not-measured, which is correct but empty.

providers.label: SerpAPI
providers.purpose: Real Google SERP over plain HTTP, from anywhere.
providers.unique_value: The ONLY route to LinkedIn: it honours site:linkedin.com/posts. DuckDuckGo refuses site: outright and Bright Data is suspended.
providers.reason: 239 search(es) left this month. Sole LinkedIn route, 1 search per brand per sweep.

providers.label: ScrapingBee
providers.purpose: JS-rendering scraper with a stealth proxy.
providers.unique_value: The only route that defeats the review-directory bot walls (G2, Capterra) AND DuckDuckGo's block page from a datacentre IP. Measured on G2: default HTTP 500, premium a 2.5KB challenge, stealth 948KB of real HTML.
providers.reason: 733 credit(s) of 1000 left

providers.label: ScrapeBadger
providers.purpose: Bulk scraping, intended to carry volume so ScrapingBee's scarcer credits are saved for hard pages.
providers.reason: 0 credits (tier free). It also DECLINES bot walls with 422, so it never covered the pages ScrapingBee is needed for. Zero-credit value: nil.
providers.action: Recharge, or remove it: the chain is direct -> ScrapingBee without it, which is what it has effectively been.

providers.label: twitterapi.io
providers.purpose: X/Twitter keyword search and timelines without an account login.
providers.unique_value: The only working route to X. x_twikit needed real credentials and never collected once; Bright Data's X dataset died with the account and had no keyword search anyway.
providers.reason: -518 credits — the balance goes NEGATIVE rather than stopping at zero, and every endpoint answers HTTP 402. The X channel is unavailable, not empty.
providers.action: Recharge at twitterapi.io, or accept X reporting unavailable.

providers.label: Windsor.ai
providers.purpose: GA4 for our own properties — the OUTCOME side of AI visibility.
providers.unique_value: First-party traffic that actually arrived from an AI assistant. No competitor-facing source can measure this; it is our own analytics.
providers.reason: 1213 AI-assistant session(s) of 110448 in 30d — free to query, so it also covers when DataForSEO is dry

providers.label: SearXNG
providers.purpose: Self-hosted metasearch: one HTTP GET returning results from many engines.
providers.unique_value: Aggregates engines behind one maintained parser, and its instance IP is not the one DuckDuckGo has blocked.
providers.reason: not reachable at http://localhost:8888: no SearXNG instance at http://localhost:8888 (HTTP no response). Start. It is OPTIONAL — the keyless layer is the floor — but it is the cheapest way to get search results without a blocked IP.
providers.action: Start it: npm run searxng:local (Docker) — or leave it off and accept DuckDuckGo needing a proxy.

providers.label: Octolens
providers.reason: REMOVED. The key is valid; the API answers HTTP 403 — access is not on this plan. No call protocol exists to fix in code.
providers.action: Re-add only if the account is upgraded to Pro, Scale or Enterprise.

providers.label: NewsAPI
providers.reason: REMOVED. It authenticated and answered — and returned the same single result that free Google News RSS returns for the same brand. The developer plan also caps retrieval at page 1 and truncates content to ~200 chars. Up, and contributing nothing.
providers.action: Google News RSS covers this. Re-add only if the plan changes.

providers.label: Bright Data
providers.reason: REMOVED. /status answers HTTP 200, but the scraper trigger both adapters depended on fails with "Customer is not active". Reading works; collecting does not.
providers.action: LinkedIn is served by SerpAPI, X by twitterapi.io. Re-add only if the account is reactivated.
